# Build the grid based on the pattern analysis
H, W = 28, 28
grid = np.zeros((H, W), dtype=int)

# Blue (1): anti-diagonal i + j = 9, for rows 0-9
for i in range(10):
    grid[i, 9-i] = 1

# Green (5): anti-diagonal i + j = 28, for rows 1-24
for i in range(1, 25):
    j = 28 - i
    grid[i, j] = 5

# Red (3): anti-diagonal i - j = 9, for rows 9-27
# This means j = i - 9
for i in range(9, 28):
    j = i - 9
    grid[i, j] = 3

# Yellow (4): anti-diagonal i + j = 52, for rows 25-27

    j = 52 - i
    grid[i, j] = 4
